channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kentavious Caldwell-Pope | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kentavious Caldwell-Pope from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
item.description:
Jaylen Brown:

“I have played against Kentavious Caldwell-Pope for a long time and every single one he has been a dog. Guards, takes the tough matchups, guards the best player. He has guarded me a lot of times. His shots when he is open and also just is a great connector for your team, so I am looking forward to being on the same side of him this year and we look forward to his leadership.”

Jaylen Brown on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Oct 6, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jeff Weltman on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Cole Anthony
item.description:
Added Weltman:

“We want to thank Cole (Anthony) and Kenny (Caldwell-Pope) for their contributions to the Orlando Magic. They have been true professionals and we wish them well.”

Jeff Weltman on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Cole Anthony, Jun 15, 2025. Source: Twitter @therealBeede.

item.title: Michael Porter Jr on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
item.description:
Nuggets teammate Michael Porter Jr. told Andscape.

“It was me and him and KCP [ex-Nuggets teammate Kentavious Caldwell-Pope] ended up pulling up. We sat there, digested it, talked. And we were there for him. He’s held it down since the day it happened. That was his big brother.”

Michael Porter Jr on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Apr 29, 2025. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Aaron Gordon on Jeff Green, Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
item.description:
Gordon said confidently to Nuggets.com.

“I hate losing [Kentavious Caldwell-Pope] and Jeff Green, but I like our additions.”

Aaron Gordon on Jeff Green, Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Oct 12, 2024. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
item.description:
Anthony Edwards on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope:

“That’s my brother. That’s my brother. That’s my big brother, for sure. And I’m tryin to tear his head off.”

Anthony Edwards on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, May 3, 2024. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Bruce Brown on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
item.description:
Bruce Brown on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope:

“He is the only one on this team that’s won a championship. He knows what it takes. We’ve got to listen to him.”

Bruce Brown on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, May 26, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Kyle Kuzma
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Frank Vogel on Kyle Kuzma and Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, 2020 Lakers champions who return tonight with the Wizards:

“Nothing but love for those guys … they’ll always be family … it was very hard to see them go, but that’s the nature of this business.”

Frank Vogel on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Kyle Kuzma, Mar 11, 2022. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Kyle Kuzma on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Jamal Murray, Alex Caruso
item.description:
“Look at Denver with Murray, even looking at the Heat this year how many injuries they had, along with us, too. Having AD out, Bron out, [Kentavious Caldwell-Pope] out a few games, [Alex] Caruso out a few games, a lot of people missed games, and I contribute that to the bubble.”

Kyle Kuzma on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Jamal Murray, Alex Caruso, Jul 8, 2021. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Bobby Portis on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
item.description:
“I went for the ball. My intent was never to hurt anybody or anything like that. Just trying to make a play on the ball. Missed the ball and hit him in the head. My apologies to Caldwell-Pope. Happy to see him go out and do his thing, come back into the game and impact the game.”

Bobby Portis on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Jan 8, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: LeBron James on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Brandon Ingram, Josh Hart
item.description:
LeBron James:

“I think more importantly than what I need to share with the younger guys, I think what a lot of people are missing is how hungry for knowledge that the young guys are. Kuz and Zo and Josh Hart, and Brandon Ingram, and Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Slavi (LeBron definitely meant Svi Mykhailluk but this is hilarious) and Moe Wagner, we have young guys that are extremely excited not only about playing the game, but also learning the game. That’s going to help out even more because those guys are just hungry for knowledge, so I’m looking forward to that.”

LeBron James on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Brandon Ingram, Josh Hart, Sep 18, 2018. Source: lebronwire.usatoday.com.

item.title: Luke Walton on Corey Brewer, Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
item.description:
Luke Walton:

“A lot of it is what they’ve [Kentavious Caldwell-Pope and Corey Brewer] brought to the table those two. Being a hard-nose, being able to make the right read and switch and get after people, be the aggressors on that end of it, and they play like that in practice all the time too. I thought our young guys see what that looks like and they get a feel of what that’s like playing against each day in practice. Obviously there’s a lot of other reasons too, but that’s a big part of what’s helped change the way that we’re playing defense.”

Luke Walton on Corey Brewer, Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Nov 21, 2017. Source: Lakers Nation.

item.title: Tom Gores on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
item.description:
#PistonsTom Gores on re-signing Kentavious Caldwell-Pope:

“He's very, very important to us -- and I'm confident we will keep him.”

Tom Gores on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Sep 26, 2016. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Markieff Morris on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
item.description:
“Caldwell-Pope got it and you know he doesn't have any heart, so we knew he was going to miss,”

Markieff Morris on Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Nov 20, 2014. Source: Detroit Free Press.
